421850.overview:
The game is a “spot the difference” game.  You have an animated image on the left and the mirrored version on the right with 5 differences.  Moving the cursor around you have to find the differences, each worth a different amount of points.

The WaiWai Check games were part of the radio show Hikaru Ijuin’s King of After School (伊集院光の放課後の王様, Ijuin Hikaru no Houkago no Ousama) hosted by Hikaru Ijūin.

The "3/21" release contains two stages; "Heian Period Emaki" and "Waiwai Submarine".
